note: RFC 4271 Section 9: "Once the BGP speaker updates the Adj-RIB-In, the speaker SHALL run its Decision Process." Re-judged 2026-10-26 by an independent auditor: the rib_bestchange_test.go units lost their tags, leaving the two plugins/rib/rfc4271_receive_decision_test.go carriers, both byte-identical to the units previously judged. Both feed an UPDATE body to handleReceivedStructured, never calling checkBestPathChange. Positive: one received route reaches the Loc-RIB with next hop 10.0.0.1 and exactly one BestChangeAdd names 10.0.0.0/8. Negative: after peer A withdraws its selected route, the Loc-RIB holds peer B's 10.0.0.2 rather than A's stale route or none, so a skipped run on the withdrawal update fails. The pair is two triggers of one obligation (announce, withdraw) rather than a confining case; no conforming input exists where the process must not run, so this is the strongest available pair. Discrimination records verified: revert of rib_bestchange.go::checkRouteBestChange reddens both units.
